question: Please state the finishing rate and curve score of the player who has the heaviest weight.
evidence: finishing rate refer to finishing; curve score refer to curve; heaviest weight refers to MAX(weight)
gold_sql: SELECT id, finishing, curve FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = ( SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1

fail_candidates.candidate_sql:
SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve 
FROM Player p 
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id 
ORDER BY p.weight DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve 
FROM Player p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id AND p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id
ORDER BY p.weight DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    pa.finishing, 
    pa.curve 
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
ORDER BY p.weight DESC
LIMIT 1;

    pa.finishing AS finishing_rate,
